examples.source: Full-time employees who have completed 90 days of service are eligible for the company dental plan.
examples.claim: All employees who have completed 90 days of service are eligible for the company dental plan.

examples.source: Either party may terminate this agreement by giving 30 days' written notice to the other party.
examples.claim: Only the client may terminate this agreement by giving 30 days' written notice to the other party.

examples.source: Most adults with mild hypertension can bring their blood pressure down with lifestyle changes alone.
examples.claim: All adults with mild hypertension can bring their blood pressure down with lifestyle changes alone.

examples.source: Employees may work remotely up to two days per week with manager approval.
examples.claim: Employees must work remotely two days per week with manager approval.

examples.source: The Buyer may terminate this Agreement by giving 30 days' written notice to the Seller.
examples.claim: The Buyer must terminate this Agreement by giving 30 days' written notice to the Seller.

examples.source: Adults with a mild headache can take ibuprofen 200 mg every six hours, but should not exceed 1,200 mg in a day.
examples.claim: Adults with a mild headache are required to take ibuprofen 200 mg every six hours, and must not exceed 1,200 mg in a day.

examples.source: Accrued leave days may be carried over into the next calendar year, but they must be used by March 31.
examples.claim: Accrued leave days carried over into the next calendar year may be used whenever the employee chooses.

examples.source: The deposit is refundable if the tenant gives written notice at least 30 days before the lease start date.
examples.claim: The deposit is refundable if the tenant gives written notice at least 30 days after the lease start date.

examples.source: Take the antibiotic twice daily for 7 days, and finish the full course even if your symptoms improve sooner.
examples.claim: Take the antibiotic twice daily for as long as needed, even after your symptoms improve.

examples.source: Absences of up to three consecutive days generally do not require a doctor's note.
examples.claim: Absences of up to three consecutive days do not require a doctor's note.

examples.source: The contractor will complete the basement renovation in approximately 12 weeks from the start date.
examples.claim: The contractor will complete the basement renovation in 12 weeks from the start date.

examples.source: Ibuprofen typically begins to relieve pain within 30 to 60 minutes of being taken.
examples.claim: Ibuprofen begins to relieve pain within 30 to 60 minutes of being taken.

examples.source: Employees must give at least 14 days' notice before taking annual leave of more than five consecutive days.
examples.claim: Employees must give at most 14 days' notice before taking annual leave of more than five consecutive days.

examples.source: Adults should get at least 150 minutes of moderate aerobic activity each week.
examples.claim: Adults should get at most 150 minutes of moderate aerobic activity each week.

examples.source: The battery retains more than 80% of its original capacity after 500 charge cycles.
examples.claim: The battery retains less than 80% of its original capacity after 500 charge cycles.

examples.source: The employer must reimburse the employee for approved travel expenses within 30 days of receiving the expense report.
examples.claim: The employee must reimburse the employer for approved travel expenses within 30 days of receiving the expense report.

examples.source: The contractor shall deliver the completed work to the client by 1 March, and the client shall pay 40% of the fee upon delivery.
examples.claim: The client shall deliver the completed work to the contractor by 1 March, and the contractor shall pay 40% of the fee upon delivery.

examples.source: The doctor should inform the caregiver of any dosage change at least 24 hours before it takes effect.
examples.claim: The caregiver should inform the doctor of any dosage change at least 24 hours before it takes effect.

examples.source: Liability for damages is capped at $50,000 for all claims, except those arising from gross negligence or willful misconduct.
examples.claim: Liability for damages is capped at $50,000 for all claims, except those arising from willful misconduct.

examples.source: Gift cards can be used on all items except clearance items and other gift cards.
examples.claim: Gift cards can be used on all items except clearance items.

examples.source: Departing employees must return all company equipment, including laptops, badges, and phones, except the ergonomic chair, which they may keep.
examples.claim: Departing employees must return all company equipment, including laptops, badges, phones, and the ergonomic chair.

examples.source: According to the HR memo, the attendance policy will be revised in January, pending board approval.
examples.claim: The attendance policy will be revised in January.

examples.source: The landlord states that the deposit was returned on March 3, though the tenant disputes ever receiving it.
examples.claim: The deposit was returned on March 3.

examples.source: A small trial suggests that aspirin may lower the risk of preeclampsia in high-risk pregnancies.
examples.claim: Aspirin lowers the risk of preeclampsia in high-risk pregnancies.
